page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at top, centred. Page number at top right. Sections XXXVII to XL are numbered by bare Roman numerals on their own lines, with citations in italics after each section.

main_text.p: pere cupiunt, audiētes dicente Apostolo, Huiusmodi Christo Domino nostro non seruiunt, sed suo ventri. Et perdulces sermones & benedictiones seducunt corda innocentium. lib.1. Dialogorum adu.Pelagium.

Ita infecit [hæc Secta] corda multorum, vt cùm superatos damnatosque esse se sentiant, tamen venena mentium non omittant: & quod solù possunt nos oderunt, per quos putant se libertatem docendæ hæreseos perdidisse. Item. Exceptis verbis tinnulis & emendicatis, nihil aliud loquitur. Epist.79.ad Alyp.& Augusti.

De purissimo fonte Scripturarum assumentes testimonia, non ita interpretantur vt scripta sunt, sed simplicitatem sermonis Ecclesiastici id volunt significare quod ipsi sentiant. Epist.60.ad Ioannem Hierosolymitanum.

Dispensatio ac libratio ista prudens verborum indoctos decipere potest. Cautus auditor & lector cito deprehendet insidias, & cuniculos, quibus veritas subuertitur, aperte in luce demonstrabit. Item. Venena erroris circumlinebant melle verborum. Item. Eadem nunc in veteri & noua hæresi consuetudo seruatur, vt aliud populi audiant, aliud prædicent sacerdotes. Epist.61.ad Pammachium.
Dum inter multum magistrorum & venena pariter bibunt, à magistro Apostolo recesserunt,

page.notes: Section XL ends with a full line and no catchword, so the paragraph continues on the next page. The words "pariter bibunt, à magistro Apostolo recesserunt" are underlined in the scan; this is most likely a mark on the paper, not printed text, so I have not reproduced it as emphasis. The form "recesserunt" is read from a worn letter and may be "recesserūt". In "ad Alyp.& Augusti" the name "Alyp." is read with some uncertainty. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible on the right margin and is not transcribed. The "Item." words are italic, and the bracketed "[hæc Secta]" is printed in the original as an interpolation.
